title: ROOM 5 ACT I -- RETROSPECTIVE AUDIT AGAINST THE FACTORY V2 ROOM CONTRACT (2026-09-05)
note: Report only: nothing here was fixed by this audit. `atProduction` is how the item stood when Room 5 first met it; `now` is how it stands against the contract today. A FAIL at production that is a PASS now is the lesson the contract carries; the bug->check ledger in docs/46-room-factory.md names the check each one became.

rows.requirement: Act, entry state and time of day known before any art
rows.note: The day candidate was generated before the time-of-day question was asked; the audit came after and cost the night plate. Outcome fixed by errata 64; the process lesson is gate A.

rows.note: The floorboard was PLATE at the gate and became STATEFUL by owner playtest; gate B did not miss it -- the writing describes a physical fact the plate did not draw (gate G).

rows.note: Thad walked in one family and stood in another; head-on idle-breaks played a mid-stride frame. Fixed and frozen (Q107); profile chore clips remain acknowledged debt.

rows.requirement: An occupied character with a pool of breaks; >=60 s live idle proof
rows.note: Winnie writes; three engine faults found by the life proof (Q25) and fixed before the pilot closed.

rows.note: Hands 16 px above the ledger and the stand 29 px above the counter at first proof; corrected twice on Tyler's review; the four-panel proof now asserts contact bands.

rows.requirement: A written physical irregularity is perceivable at gameplay scale and found on a natural route
rows.note: Flush board (Q108); iteration 1 too subtle and off-route; iteration 2 a DAY board on the NIGHT plate; treatment C accepted. Three rounds.
